title: Effective Federal Funds Rate
summary: The Effective Federal Funds Rate (DFF) remained flat at 3.64% from April 18 through April 22, 2026. This represents a daily observed rate, not a policy decision. The rate shows no change from the prior observation on April 21, 2026.
